prompt: Create a vertical 4:5 close-up photograph of a handmade yarn-and-embroidery-thread wall art piece on a pale whitewashed wooden board, styled like a one-of-a-kind fiber portrait rather than a flat illustration. The central subject is an anime girl named original character, shown from the waist up, made entirely from layered strands of yarn, embroidery floss, knots, braided cords, and stitched outlines. She has pale blue and white long wavy hair formed from many loose individual threads, bright sparkling blue embroidered eyes, rosy stitched cheeks, and an open smiling mouth. Her outfit is a frilly black-and-white maid dress with puff sleeves, scalloped lace edges, a white ruffled headdress, a small blue bow at the collar, and tiny pink-and-blue crocheted flower decorations in her hair, earrings, chest, and sleeves. Emphasize tactile fiber texture: raised thread lines, fuzzy wool, visible knots, soft shadows, uneven handmade stitching, and embroidery-style contour lines that reconstruct the hair flow, lace, skin blush, bouquet-like flowers, and clothing folds. Surround the wall art with crafting props arranged on the wooden tabletop/background: exactly 1 pinned paper sign in the upper left with the Japanese text 毛糸の線画\n一点物ウォールデコ\n制作中, exactly 1 blue thread spool on the left with loose blue yarn trailing into the artwork, exactly 1 monochrome pencil sketch sheet beneath it showing the same character as a design draft, exactly 1 wooden crate at bottom left containing 3 yarn balls in pink, pale blue, and cream, exactly 2 thread spools on the right edge in pink and cream, exactly 1 ornate pair of embroidery scissors at bottom right, and exactly 1 small sprig of pale pink dried flowers near the upper right. Use soft natural daylight, warm pastel tones, shallow shadows, realistic craft photography, high detail, cozy handmade studio atmosphere, no digital flat coloring, no extra characters, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一张 4:5 比例的竖版特写照片，展示一件手工毛线与绣花线墙面艺术品，背景为浅色刷白木质项目，呈现出独一无二的纤维肖像质感，而非平面插画。中心主体是一位名为 原创角色 的动漫少女，展示腰部以上部分，完全由层叠的毛线、绣花线、结、编织绳和缝合轮廓构成。她拥有 淡蓝色和白色 的长波浪发，由许多松散的独立线束组成，明亮闪烁的蓝色刺绣眼睛，红润的缝合脸颊，以及微张的笑脸。她的服装是一件黑白相间的荷叶边女仆装，带有泡泡袖、扇形蕾丝边缘、白色褶皱头饰、领口处的小蓝蝴蝶结，以及头发、耳环、胸前和袖口上微小的粉蓝色钩针花朵装饰。强调纤维的触感：凸起的线条、毛茸茸的羊毛、可见的线结、柔和的阴影、不均匀的手工缝线，以及重构头发流向、蕾丝、皮肤红晕、花束状花朵和衣物褶皱的刺绣风格轮廓线。在木质桌面/背景上布置工艺道具环绕墙面艺术品：左上角放置 1 个带日文文本 毛糸の線画\n一点物ウォールデコ\n制作中 的固定纸质标牌，左侧放置 1 个蓝色线轴，松散的蓝色毛线延伸至艺术品中，下方放置 1 张展示同一角色设计草图的单色铅笔素描纸，左下角放置 1 个木箱，内含 3 个粉色、淡蓝色和奶油色的毛线球，右侧边缘放置 2 个粉色和奶油色的线轴，右下角放置 1 把华丽的刺绣剪刀，右上角附近放置 1 小枝淡粉色干花。使用柔和的自然日光、温暖的柔和色调、浅淡的阴影、逼真的工艺摄影效果、高细节度、舒适的手工工作室氛围，无数字平面着色，无额外角色，无水印。
